newsitem.title: USA: BankAmerica Q3 expense ratio at 54.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica Q3 expense ratio at 54.5 pct.

text.p: BankAmerica Corp said its expense-to-revenue ratio, excluding the effect of a one-time Savings Association Insurance Fund (SAIF) recapitalization assessment, was 54.5 percent in the third quarter of 1996 versus 55.1 percent in the previous quarter.

BankAmerica on Wednesday reported third quarter net income of $1.75 a share versus $1.72 a year earlier. It said its provision for credit losses was $235 million in the third quarter, down $15 million from the second quarter of 1996, but up $125 million from the third quarter of 1995.
